primary.title: Nippon Life AMC shares: Last chance to buy for ₹9.50 interim dividend; record date, dividend yield
primary.summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management set October 28, 2026, as the record date for its ₹9.50 interim dividend, with October 27 likely the last day to buy shares and qualify. September-quarter profit fell 6% to ₹324.4 crore, partly due to a SEBI settlement, while revenue rose 21%.
